pages.title: Same Gender Won't Breed
pages.text: Two horses of the same gender won't mate. Feed a **Golden Apple** to a horse whose partner matches its gender and you'll see "These horses are the same gender and can't breed." The apple is still used and love mode resets.

pages.title: Inheritance
pages.text:
When a foal is born:

- **Gender** is a coin flip.
- **Breed** comes from one parent at 50/50. Matching parents pass it cleanly; different breeds give the foal a **(mix)** tag.
- Cross-species pairs (horse + donkey) give the matching species placeholder.

pages.title: Stat Inheritance
pages.text: Health, speed, and jump are **max(parent1, parent2) + delta**, where delta is a roll from **-0.5** to **+1.0**. Foals can beat both parents, but the ceiling is the vanilla base - no runaway superhorses.

pages.title: Coat Re-roll
pages.text: The foal's coat is re-rolled from the coats its inherited breed allows. Two **Quarter** horses always give a Quarter-pattern coat; a mixed pair can surprise you with either side's palette.
